[Action needed]
Spotify rejected the saved login
================================

Spotify refused the refresh token that spotify-tracker uses. Listening history is not being recorded until this is fixed.

This happens when the token expires or access is revoked. Re-authorize Spotify to fix it. Spotify said:

    spotify: refresh token: oauth2: "invalid_grant" "Refresh token revoked"

Re-authorize Spotify:
  https://listening.example.com/admin/settings/spotify

The poller picks up the new token automatically.

-- 
Sent by spotify-tracker · listening.example.com (https://listening.example.com)
You get these because you're an alert recipient. Change it in Settings → Email alerts:
  https://listening.example.com/admin/settings/email
